description: HBD canonical form field: label + input + hint/error/success + live char-count + prefix/suffix + password eye toggle. Owns the shared .hbd-field chrome (and the form-validation helpers) that textarea, otp-input, select trigger, stepper, and combobox reuse. sm/md/lg sizes, error/success/disabled/readonly states, aria-invalid + aria-describedby wiring, controlled-first value.
